description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: ring.ts's HashRing picks a node with `hashInt(key) % nodes.length` - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: the constructor takes (nodes: string[], replicas: number) and places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via node's crypto.createHash('md5') over `${node}:${i}` for each virtual point (use `declare function require(id: string): any;` to get an untyped crypto module - @types/node is not installed in this sandbox). getNode(key: string): string hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). addNode(node: string): void and removeNode(node: string): void update the ring in place. The file must compile under tsc --strict.
name: add_ts_consistent_hash_ring

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit ring.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build ring.ts
node behavior_test.js
